title: Reproducing Yano et al. 2002: interface states on wet-oxidized 4H-SiC (03-38) and (0001)

sample.paper: “n-type 4H-SiC substrates with surface orientations of (03-38) and (0001)”
“prepared by slicing ingots grown on (000-1) … with an angle of 54.7° toward the <01-10> direction”; “semi-equivalent to 3C(cubic)-SiC(100)”
sample.note: Recorded on the sample; no program has constants for this face, so the growth program runs the Si face and the interface-state program says it was measured on the Si face only.

sample.ours: DOPING: n_type_3.2e17 / n_type_8.7e16 (recorded; no program reads it)

sample.paper: CVD at 1520 °C, SiH4 + C3H8 in H2; thickness not stated
Al, 300 µm diameter (printed “300 mm”), Al back contact

history.paper: “N-type epitaxial layers were grown by standard atmospheric-pressure cold-wall chemical vapor deposition (CVD) at 1520 °C using SiH4 and C3H8 as source gases and H2 as a carrier gas.”
“The samples were cleaned by an RCA method”
history.note: Whether the RCA sequence ended with an HF dip is not said; the vocabulary's RCA words are silicon cleans.

history.paper: “and then loaded immediately into the oxidation furnace.”
“Wet oxidation was performed at 1150 °C to grow a thermal oxide. The oxidation time/thickness were 25 min/67 nm for (03-38) and 120 min/45 nm for (0001)”
history.ours: RUN WetOxidation DURATION 7200 TEMP 1150->1150 AMBIENT mix:H2O=0.842,O2=0.158
history.note: How the steam was made and its partial pressure are not stated. Deal and Grove's 95 °C bubbler (0.842 atm water in oxygen) is ours.

history.item: Steam still present at the switch to argon
history.paper: not stated: “After thermal oxidation, in situ post-oxidation annealing was carried out”
history.ours: RUN Purge DURATION 1 TEMP 1150->1150 AMBIENT mix:H2O=0.842,O2=0.158
history.note: The switch from steam to argon in the same tube takes some time; 1 s (none) is ours, searched to 10 min.

history.paper: “in situ post-oxidation annealing was carried out at 1150 °C for 30 min in Ar.”
history.ours: RUN ArgonAnneal DURATION 1800 TEMP 1150->1150 AMBIENT inert_Ar
the history continues at the next stated step

history.item: Al gate (300 µm) and Al back contact
history.paper: “Al was deposited on the surface as a gate electrode with a diameter of 300 mm and also on the back side for an ohmic contact.”
history.note: “300 mm” is a misprint for 300 µm. Deposition method not stated.

history.paper: “post-metallization annealing was done in a forming gas (10% H2 in N2) at 400 °C for 30 min.”
history.ours: RUN PMA DURATION 1800 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT forming_gas_H2
history.note: Heat-up and cooling of this anneal are not stated.

history.item: C-V at 300 and 100 K; conductance at 300 K
history.paper: “high-frequency (1 MHz) C–V characteristics were measured at room temperature (300 K) and at a low temperature (100 K) … The interface state density was calculated from the peak value of the parallel conductance measured in the frequency range of 1 kHz to 1 MHz at room temperature.”
history.ours: the observable Dit at 0.3 and 0.4 eV below the conduction band
history.note: Conductance method, 300 K; it covers 0.09 to 0.41 eV below the conduction band.
